svg.title: Where Payvol fits with CBTC
svg.desc: Who asks for payment (ERP and invoicing, point of sale, AI agents, any app) creates a Payvol request: a link, QR or NFC tag the payer verifies before signing, reconciled privately. The request is paid with a wallet as one Canton Token Standard transfer, designed for any wallet, with privacy by Canton; the Token Standard carries Canton Coin, stablecoins and CBTC. It settles in CBTC by BitSafe, 1:1 Bitcoin-backed, minted against BTC and redeemable for BTC. Payvol holds no funds and no keys.
svg.text: One request format, paid as a Canton Token Standard transfer of CBTC.
BTC is deposited to Taproot addresses. BitSafe's Attestor Network verifies deposits and authorizes custody with FROST threshold signatures.
Payvol holds no funds and no keys.
